courses.overview: 由EMIB 嵌入式橋接、返回路徑與組合封裝延伸到不同工法，保留物理關係並重新界定系統邊界。
courses.overviewEn: Extend EMIB embedded bridges, return paths and package composition to related methods while retaining physical relationships and redefining system boundaries.

related.title: 台積電 CoWoS 整合案例
related.why: 兩課需把晶粒邊界、密集布線和 HBM 介面共同預算。
related.whyEn: Both budget die shorelines, dense routing and HBM interfaces.
related.transfer: 兩課需把晶粒邊界、密集布線和 HBM 介面共同預算。
related.transferEn: Both budget die shorelines, dense routing and HBM interfaces.
related.difference: EMIB 是橋接平台；CoWoS-S/R/L 是不同中介與局部互連組合。
related.differenceEn: EMIB is a bridge platform; CoWoS-S/R/L use differing interposer/local-link arrangements.
practice: 為同一邏輯與記憶體配置比較布線可達性。
在兩課中各選一個能推翻結論的量測。
標出交接時不能直接沿用的材料參數或控制條件。
practiceEn: Compare routability for one logic/memory arrangement.
Choose one falsifying measurement in each course.
Identify material parameters or control conditions that cannot be transferred unchanged.

courses.summary: Intel EMIB 互連橋案例以EMIB 嵌入式橋接、返回路徑與組合封裝連結元件物理與系統驗證。此代表地點用於認識研究與封裝供應鏈；課程由多個公開來源交叉編寫。
courses.summaryEn: Intel EMIB bridge case study links device physics and system validation through EMIB embedded bridges, return paths and package composition. This representative location illustrates the research and packaging ecosystem; the curriculum draws on several public sources.
courses.connection: 以EMIB 嵌入式橋接、返回路徑與組合封裝比較相關工法；重新核對材料、波段、控制拓撲與驗收門檻。
courses.connectionEn: Compare related methods through EMIB embedded bridges, return paths and package composition, rechecking materials, wavelength, control topology and acceptance limits.

history.title: EMIB 從橋接走向更多功能
history.titleEn: EMIB evolves beyond a basic bridge
history.text: Intel 公開記錄 EMIB 自 2017 年量產，並介紹加入電容的 M 與含 TSV 的 T 變體。本課避免把早期無 TSV 的概述套到整個平台族。
history.textEn: Intel records EMIB production from 2017 and describes M with capacitors and T with TSVs. The course avoids applying an early no-TSV description to the entire family.

history.year: 設計延伸（未標年） / Undated design context
history.title: 比較橋接與其他整合路線
history.titleEn: Compare bridges with other integration routes
history.text: TSMC 的 CoWoS 變體提供不同中介與局部互連的公開比較背景。本課據此比較同一晶粒拓撲的布線與供電，而不從品牌推定某種方式一定最低成本。
history.textEn: TSMC CoWoS variants supply alternative interposer/local-link context. The course compares routing and power for one die topology rather than inferring lowest cost from a brand.
